de.abas.erp.api.customize

Class FopEventHandle

  • Object
    • AbasComponent
      • Fop
        • FopEventHandle
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Comparable<AbasComponent>, Iterable<AbasComponent>

    public class FopEventHandle
extends Fop
    Implements an Efop as a composite which extends a Fop. Each FopEventHandle has of course its Fop as well as its EventHandleItem which describes the record location of the item this fop is registered in.
